method: data_element_tool get_all_elements depth 4 on both pages, plus query_elements children_depth -1 on the hero-left and quiz-panel subtrees of the invisalign page. Trees below are faithful condensations (type + styleNames + tag + key attributes/text); element ids kept only for section roots.

HtmlEmbed  (THE QUIZ FORM ITSELF IS AN HTML EMBED — steps/inputs are not native Webflow elements)

new-patient-special-consultation.structure: Structurally identical to invisalign-consultation at depth 4: Body > div.page_quiz > [ header.imp-header (same logo/nav), section.section_qz-hero #quiz (qz-hero__glow + qz-hero__grid > landing-hero-grid-left + qz-div), section.qz-div.section_qz-stories.lw-sec (imp-consult-stories labels + imp-ty-videos HtmlEmbed + qz-stories__foot with the same 'Mason park Dental' typo), section.qz-div.section_qz-proof.lw-sec (same drift marquee 'implants · comfort · craft'), footer.ty-foot ]. Same class vocabulary, same HtmlEmbed usage. Only text/asset details differ deeper down.

verdict.buildStyle: Native Webflow elements (Blocks/Sections/Headings/Spans/Paragraphs with real Webflow classes) for the page shell, BUT the interactive quiz form and the stories video wall are HtmlEmbeds. Not converter output (no numbered p-/div- classes), and NOT Client-First: the vocabulary is a patchwork of four families reused across pages: imp-* (header/nav from the invisalign LP), qz-* BEM (quiz-specific), landing-* (hero/typography), ty-* (footer from the thank-you pages), plus lw-* shell classes that came from the Livewell Dental quiz build this page was evidently copied from.
verdict.componentsUsed: none — zero ComponentInstances on either page
verdict.clientFirstClassesUsed: only the section_qz-* / page_quiz naming convention mimics Client-First section naming; no padding-global/container-*/heading-style-* used
